from.description: Source dialect (shell language) to convert from. Must be one of the supported dialects: bash, csh, ksh, modulecmd, perl, plist, sh, tclsh, tcsh, vim, yaml, zsh.

to.description: Target dialect (shell language) to convert to. Must be one of the supported dialects.

output.description: Output file path. If empty or omitted, stdout is used. If specified without path, defaults to 'env2.' + $SHELL.

profile.description: Path to file containing the starting environment (default: '.env2profile' in current directory or $HOME).

ignore.description: Additional variables to ignore (beyond default list: _, ENV, ENV2, OLDPWD, SHLVL). Items must be scalar variable names.

all_vars.description: If true, include all variables (even unchanged ones). By default (false), only changed variables are included.

uniq.description: List of PATH-like variables to deduplicate (colon-separated values). If empty or not provided, defaults to [MANPATH, PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, PERL5LIB]. Set to ['*'] to apply to all PATH variables.
